title: Saloma Link Active-Mobility Corridor — Illustrative Demo
description: A curated demonstration exploring how Kuala Lumpur Development Plan 2040 active-mobility policy intent may relate to a bounded KL Central / Saloma Link route. This is an illustrative route-evidence mapping, not an official construction or accessibility finding.
